purpose: Verify generated MESH callback delivery of all modeled DXF fields: version, blend-crease flag, subdivision level, vertices, face indices, edge indices, crease values, and ordered sub-entity property overrides.

authority.relevantFields: MESH group codes describe version, blend-crease state, subdivision level, level-0 vertices/faces/edges/creases, and sub-entity property override counts, markers, and property types.

scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF callback transport only for modeled MESH fields. The DWG-only unknown tail and legacy subdivVertices slot are excluded; this does not qualify native mesh construction, independent interoperability, DWG producer semantics, or broader MESH support.
claimEffect: No format or consumer support claim changes.
